  • Constructor Details

    • ObjectiveRankingPolicy

      public ObjectiveRankingPolicy(String id, String name, String provenance, int objectiveIndex, String objectiveName, ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.ObjectiveDefinition.Direction objectiveDirection, String unit, double weight, double tieTolerance, double baselineRelativeTolerance)
      Creates an exact single-objective comparison policy.
      Parameters:
      id - stable policy identifier
      name - human-readable policy name
      provenance - source and assumptions for the policy
      objectiveIndex - exact registered objective index
      objectiveName - exact registered objective name
      objectiveDirection - direction in which the raw objective improves
      unit - exact engineering unit of objective values and deltas
      weight - exact registered objective weight
      tieTolerance - non-negative tie tolerance in the objective unit
      baselineRelativeTolerance - relative tolerance in [0, 1] for repeated baseline values
